_comment: MCP Registry entry. Verify the current schema version + field names with `mcp-publisher` (the schema evolves). Namespace uses the GitHub-owned form io.github.<owner>/<repo>, which the registry verifies via the repo. Publish only after the GitHub repo is public and the PyPI package is live.
name: io.github.gearotons/servomotor-mcp
description: Drive Gearotons M17 open-source servomotors from natural language over RS-485. Discovers serial ports, auto-detects motors on the bus, and exposes the motor firmware's full command set as MCP tools. Ships a mock backend (no hardware needed).

environmentVariables.name: GEAROTONS_MOTOR_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: 'auto' (default: real serial backend when the servomotor library is installed, mock otherwise), 'serial', or 'mock'.

environmentVariables.name: GEAROTONS_SERIAL_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Optional default port for the connect tool (e.g. /dev/cu.usbserial-210, /dev/ttyUSB0, COM3). Normally unnecessary — the model discovers ports with list_serial_ports.

environmentVariables.name: GEAROTONS_DEFAULT_SPEED_DPS
environmentVariables.description: Default speed in degrees/second for the high-level move tools.
